divergences.summary: mro2nf stages each file leaf under an ordinal basename (L0000<ext>), so a path a stage receives in _args ends in that name where mrp passes the original basename; the extension is preserved, so received basenames are compared by extension only

the same ordinal staging reaches _outs when a phase returns a path it received, e.g. a join forwarding its chunks' file outputs; files the phase wrote in its own files dir keep full-basename comparison
